result.instructions: Tools for SuperFaktura, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my issued invoices are still unpaid, and how much is owed?"; "Show the expenses I recorded last month with the amounts."; "What is the current balance in my cash register?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SuperFaktura data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run superfaktura_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run superfaktura_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run superfaktura_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. superfaktura_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: superfaktura_get_company
tools.title: Get the company profile and API limits
tools.description: The company the API key is working in (name, IČO, DIČ, IČ DPH, address, VAT-payer flag, bank accounts) and the remaining API quota (SuperFaktura's fair-use policy is 1000 requests per day and 31000 per month; every tool call here uses one request). Good first call. With all_companies=true also the other companies the user can access (their ids are the company_id of the login). GET /users/getUserCompaniesData.

all_companies.description: true = every company the user has access to, not only the current one.

annotations.title: Get the company profile and API limits

tools.name: superfaktura_list_invoices
tools.title: List or search invoices
tools.description: List issued documents with client, items, totals and payment status. type selects the document kind (default regular = ordinary invoices; also proforma, estimate = quote, order, cancel = credit note, delivery, draft, reverse_order; several allowed). Without a date filter SuperFaktura returns only the CURRENT YEAR; use created_period='all' or a date range for older ones. status: issued, partially_paid, paid, overdue. search matches client name, number, VS ... Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /invoices/index.json.

search.description: Text to search for (matched by SuperFaktura in names, numbers, e-mails ... of the records).

order_no.description: Order number the document was created from.

created_period.description: Issue date as a period (default this_year when no date filter is given).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (the account's profile default when omitted).

tools.name: superfaktura_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One document (invoice, proforma, quote ...) with its header (number, dates, status, amounts, currency, symbols, comments), client, items, VAT summary, payments and related documents. The public access token and payment links of the document are not returned. GET /invoices/view/{id}.json.

invoice_id.description: Invoice id (the id of a superfaktura_list_invoices row).

tools.name: superfaktura_list_clients
tools.title: List or search clients
tools.description: List the address book (clients and suppliers) with contact data and totals. search matches name, IČO, DIČ, IČ DPH, bank account, e-mail, address, city, phone, note and tags. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /clients/index.json.

search.description: Text to search for (matched by SuperFaktura in names, numbers, e-mails ... of the records).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (the account's profile default when omitted).

tools.name: superfaktura_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: One client with address, tax ids, bank data, default currency/due days/discount and statistics. GET /clients/view/{id}.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_contact_persons
tools.title: List a client's contact persons
tools.description: The contact persons (name, e-mail, phone) stored for one client. GET /contact_people/getContactPeople/{client_id}.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_expenses
tools.title: List or search expenses
tools.description: List received documents (expenses: received invoices, bills, internal documents) with amounts, VAT, supplier and payment status. status: issued (new), partially_paid, paid, overdue. Without a date filter SuperFaktura applies its default period; pass created_period='all' for everything. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /expenses/index.json.

type.description: Expense type (note the vendor's spelling recieved_credit_note).

search.description: Text to search for (matched by SuperFaktura in names, numbers, e-mails ... of the records).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (the account's profile default when omitted).

tools.name: superfaktura_get_expense
tools.title: Get an expense
tools.description: One expense with its items, VAT rates, payments and supplier. Attachments are not returned. GET /expenses/view/{id}.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_expense_categories
tools.title: List expense categories
tools.description: The expense category tree (id, name, parent) for the category_id of expenses. GET /expenses/expense_categories.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: The company's bank accounts as stored in SuperFaktura (bank name, IBAN, SWIFT, default flag). GET /bank_accounts/index.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_bank_moves
tools.title: List imported bank account moves
tools.description: Bank transactions imported into SuperFaktura (date, amount, currency, variable symbol, counter account, matching state), newest first by default. Filter by date range, credit/debit or amount. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /accounts/index.json.

search.description: Text to search for (matched by SuperFaktura in names, numbers, e-mails ... of the records).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (the account's profile default when omitted).

tools.name: superfaktura_list_cash_registers
tools.title: List cash registers
tools.description: The company's cash registers with currency, number of entries and current balance (read only). GET /cash_registers/getDetails.

tools.name: superfaktura_get_cash_register
tools.title: Get a cash register
tools.description: One cash register with currency, number of entries and current balance (read only). GET /cash_registers/view/{id}.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_stock_items
tools.title: List or search stock items
tools.description: List warehouse items (name, SKU, unit, price, VAT, quantity in stock). search matches name, SKU and description; sku matches the SKU. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /stock_items/index.json.

search.description: Text to search for (matched by SuperFaktura in names, numbers, e-mails ... of the records).

in_stock_only.description: true = only items that are in stock.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (the account's profile default when omitted).

tools.name: superfaktura_get_stock_item
tools.title: Get a stock item
tools.description: One warehouse item with SKU, price, VAT, purchase price and quantity in stock. GET /stock_items/view/{id}.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_stock_movements
tools.title: List stock movements of an item
tools.description: The stock log of one item (quantity changes, notes, related invoice or expense). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /stock_items/movements/{id}.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (the account's profile default when omitted).

tools.name: superfaktura_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: The tags (id and name) usable on invoices, expenses and clients. GET /tags/index.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_sequences
tools.title: List numbering sequences
tools.description: The document numbering sequences per document type (id, name, mask, next formatted number, default flag); sequence ids are used when creating documents. GET /sequences/index.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_countries
tools.title: List countries
tools.description: SuperFaktura's country ids with ISO code and EU flag, for the country_id of clients. GET /countries/index/view_full:1.

tools.name: superfaktura_get_response_by_checksum
tools.title: Recover the reply of a create by its checksum
tools.description: If a superfaktura_create_invoice call timed out, fetch the reply of the ORIGINAL request by the checksum it was sent with (kept 3 months), so the document is not created twice. GET /api_logs/getResponseByChecksum/{checksum}.

annotations.title: Recover the reply of a create by its checksum

tools.name: superfaktura_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: WRITE: adds a new client to the SuperFaktura address book (only the name is required). Nothing is sent to the client. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two clients, so check superfaktura_list_clients first. POST /clients/create.

ic_dph.description: VAT id (IČ DPH in Slovakia, DIČ in the Czech Republic).

country_id.description: Country id (superfaktura_list_countries); Slovakia is 191. Defaults to the instance's country.

email.description: Client e-mail (stored only; nothing is sent to it).

tools.name: superfaktura_add_contact_person
tools.title: Add a contact person to a client
tools.description: WRITE: adds a contact person (name and e-mail, optional phone) to an existing client. Nothing is sent to that person. Not idempotent. POST /contact_people/add/api:1.

annotations.title: Add a contact person to a client

tools.name: superfaktura_create_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: WRITE: adds a new tag name (usable on invoices, expenses and clients in the SuperFaktura app). A duplicate name is refused by SuperFaktura. POST /tags/add.

tools.name: superfaktura_create_expense
tools.title: Record a received expense
tools.description: WRITE: records a received document (expense) with ONE total amount and VAT rate, e.g. a supplier invoice or a bill. It is created unpaid: no payment is recorded and nothing is sent. No attachments. Not idempotent: calling twice records two expenses. POST /expenses/add.

name.description: Expense name / what it is for.

tools.name: superfaktura_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an unsent invoice document
tools.description: WRITE: creates ONE document in SuperFaktura for the user to review: type draft (concept, default), estimate (quote), order or proforma. A final regular invoice cannot be created here. It is NOT sent (no e-mail, no post), NOT marked paid or sent, and has no payment link or discount. Give an existing client_id (its name is read first with one extra GET /clients/view/{id}, so the call uses 2 requests of the daily quota) OR a new client's name (+ optional ico/dic/ic_dph/address...). Items: name, unit price without VAT, VAT rate, quantity. Not idempotent: pass a checksum (max 32 chars) so a timed-out call can be recovered with superfaktura_get_response_by_checksum instead of retried. POST /invoices/create.

type.description: Document type: draft (default), estimate, order or proforma.

name.description: Document title (default generated from the number).

client_id.description: Existing client id (superfaktura_list_clients). Give this OR client_name.

client_name.description: Name of a new/matching client (used when client_id is not given).

client_address.description: Client street and number, with client_name.

client_email.description: Client e-mail, with client_name (stored only; nothing is sent).

description.description: Item description shown on the document.

unit_price.description: Unit price WITHOUT VAT (the full price when the company is not a VAT payer).

tax.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 20 (use 0 when the company is not a VAT payer).

variable.description: Variable symbol (the document number when empty).

header_comment.description: Comment above the items (shown on the document).

internal_comment.description: Internal comment (not shown on the document).

checksum.description: Your own unique token (max 32 chars) to recover the reply if the call times out.
